'''UppsaLAN''' is a [[2024]] private LAN event organized by {{Player|Peppe|flag=se}} in Uppsala, Sweden.
The event features 8 seats and is covered by [https://twitch.tv/bps__ bps] and [https://twitch.tv/peppe_qw Peppe]. The 1on1 tournament will run on friday. 

== Format ==
* '''Single-Elimination Playoffs'''
** {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} games
** dm2, dm4, dm6, aerowalk, ztndm3, bravado, skull
** No picking, every map is selected by rnd. No repeats.
